tools.name: check_contrast
tools.description: Check text/background contrast with WCAG 2 ratio, APCA Lc and a suggested fix that keeps the hue.

tools.name: convert_color
tools.description: Convert a hex color to RGB, HSL and OKLCH.

tools.name: generate_harmony
tools.description: Build a color harmony from a base color in OKLCH, mapped into the sRGB gamut.

tools.name: roll_palette
tools.description: Generate a 5-color palette that always contains a light/dark pair passing WCAG AA; optionally keep locked colors.

tools.name: export_palette
tools.description: Turn a list of colors into code for CSS, Tailwind, SwiftUI, Android, Flutter and other formats ColorPickr supports.

tools.name: simulate_color_vision
tools.description: Show how colors look with protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia or achromatopsia (Machado 2009).
